title: Hyperuniform Delone Realizations and Rigidity
summary: We prove a measurable realization theorem for hyperuniform Delone point processes. In dimensions \(d\geq2\), for every prescribed \(q\geq1\), every essentially free ergodic p.m.p.\ action of \(\mathbb R^d\) admits, at every sufficiently large prescribed intensity, a generating Delone realization whose return-time point process \(η\) is measurably isomorphic to the original action and whose Bartlett spectrum \(σ_η\) satisfies \[ σ_η(B_\varepsilon)=o(\varepsilon^{2q}) \qquad(\varepsilon\downarrow0). \] Thus arbitrarily high finite-order low-frequency suppression can be imposed without changing…
